edges.reason: Constructor stores msg.sender into the privileged creator variable.
msg.sender becomes creator/initial owner during deployment.
Constructor assigns the initial _totalSupply.
Constructor computes elephant = _totalSupply / 1250.
Constructor copies elephant into opera.
Constructor whitelists the deployer in thealpha.
getOwner delegates to owner().
owner() returns _owner.
onlyOwner modifier reads _owner for the authorization check.
onlyOwner modifier compares _owner against _msgSender().
SetBurnAddress reassigns _owner to picture with no onlyOwner guard.
SetBurnAddress uses the stored picture address as the new owner source.
The unguarded ownership-change operation writes _owner.
transferOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership forwards to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership writes the new _owner value.
newOwner parameter flows into the _owner assignment.
renounceOwnership is limited by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0).
randomly() consumes block.timestamp (now) as randomness entropy.
randomly() mixes msg.sender into the hash.
randomly() reads and increments saslaisgood.
The unsafe randomness operation depends on miner-controllable block.timestamp.
randomly() performs the predictable timestamp-based random draw.
_transfer calls randomly() to decide recipient flagging.
_transfer subtracts from and adds to _balances via SafeMath.
_transfer reads and writes thealpha flags for sender and recipient.
_transfer reads and writes rainyday flags.
_transfer enforces require(amount < elephant) for non-whitelisted senders.
_transfer clears the connyly one-shot flag after the creator's first transfer.
_transfer sender parameter drives balance and flag updates.
_transfer recipient parameter drives balance and flag updates.
_transfer amount parameter is used in unchecked-as-cap arithmetic.
transfer invokes _transfer.
transfer recipient parameter reaches _transfer.
transfer amount parameter reaches _transfer.
transfer debits _msgSender().
transferFrom invokes _transfer.
transferFrom invokes _approve to reduce the allowance.
transferFrom sender parameter flows into _transfer.
transferFrom recipient parameter flows into _transfer.
transferFrom amount parameter flows into allowance subtraction.
transferFrom subtracts the amount from _allowances via SafeMath.
approve invokes _approve.
approve spender parameter reaches the allowance write.
approve amount parameter reaches the allowance write.
increaseAllowance invokes _approve.
increaseAllowance spender parameter reaches _approve.
addedValue is summed into the allowance with SafeMath.
decreaseAllowance invokes _approve.
decreaseAllowance spender parameter reaches _approve.
subtractedValue is deducted from the allowance with SafeMath.
_approve writes the possibly overridden allowance into _allowances.
_approve reads rainyday[owner] to force the allowance to 122234.
_approve auto-whitelists the first spender when owner == creator.
_approve clears the mfiii one-shot flag.
_mint increases _totalSupply with SafeMath.
_mint increases the target balance with SafeMath.
FruitBowl invokes _mint.
FruitBowl is restricted by onlyOwner.
FruitBowl amount parameter becomes the minted amount.
_burn decreases the target balance with SafeMath.
_burn decreases _totalSupply with SafeMath.
_burnFrom invokes _burn.
_burnFrom invokes _approve to reduce the caller allowance.
BurnSomeWolfs overwrites the elephant transfer cap.
BurnSomeWolfs is restricted by onlyOwner.
BurnSomeWolfs amount parameter directly sets elephant.
CheckTheAddress writes arbitrary thealpha whitelist values.
CheckTheAddress writes arbitrary rainyday flag values.
CheckTheAddress is restricted by onlyOwner.
CheckTheAddress spender parameter selects the flagged address.
CheckTheAddress val parameter is written into thealpha.
CheckTheAddress val2 parameter is written into rainyday.
ViewTheRate reads _totalSupply.
ViewTheRate is restricted by onlyOwner.
ViewTheRate copies _totalSupply into the local tempval.
Ownable constructor stores _msgSender() as the initial _owner.
Local tok carries the possibly overridden allowance value inside _approve.
Local screen holds the pseudo-random result inside randomly().

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a parameter whose only role is the _owner write in _transferOwnership; fold it into that function node.
recipient_transfer parameterizes transfer and has no independent semantics.
amount_transfer parameterizes transfer and has no independent semantics.
sender_transferFrom parameterizes transferFrom; fold into the transferFrom function node.
recipient_transferFrom parameterizes transferFrom; fold into the transferFrom function node.
amount_transferFrom parameterizes transferFrom; fold into the transferFrom function node.
spender_approve parameterizes approve; fold into the approve function node.
amount_approve parameterizes approve; fold into the approve function node.
spender_increaseAllowance parameterizes increaseAllowance.
addedValue parameterizes increaseAllowance and feeds the SafeMath add.
spender_decreaseAllowance parameterizes decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameterizes decreaseAllowance and feeds the SafeMath sub.
amount_BurnSomeWolfs is the value assigned to elephant inside that function.
amount_FruitBowl is forwarded to _mint from FruitBowl.
spender_CheckTheAddress selects the flagged entry inside CheckTheAddress.
val_CheckTheAddress is written to thealpha inside CheckTheAddress.
val2_CheckTheAddress is written to rainyday inside CheckTheAddress.
sender_transfer is an internal _transfer argument with no standalone behavior.
recipient_transfer_internal is an internal _transfer argument with no standalone behavior.
amount_transfer_internal is the value compared to elephant and moved in _balances.
account_mint is the credited address inside _mint.
amount_mint is the minted value inside _mint.
account_burn is the debited address inside _burn.
amount_burn is the burned value inside _burn.
account_burnFrom is forwarded from _burnFrom into _burn.
amount_burnFrom is forwarded from _burnFrom into _burn and _approve.
tempval is a purely local copy of _totalSupply inside ViewTheRate.
screen is the local pseudo-random result inside randomly().
tok is the local allowance value computed inside _approve.
msgSender is the local copy of _msgSender() used by the constructor to set the owner.
